mod.name: Auto Fishing (wait phase verified/experimental)
config.status.experimental: Experimental: F6 first proves the hotkey chain; full auto fishing is not stable yet. Current state: {0}.
config.boundary.current: Current boundary: the selected fishing rod is required, auto recast is always normalized on, auto-complete is delayed success forcing, skip is not an independent minigame skip, and fast animation can no-op unless the animator path is available.
config.toggleKey.name: Toggle key
config.toggleKey.tooltip: Toggles auto fishing. DTMAPI configuration is opened from the title settings button.
config.infoKey.name: Info key
config.infoKey.tooltip: Opens this config page until the fish-info UI page is promoted.
config.autoRecast.name: Auto recast
config.autoRecast.tooltip: Cast again after a fishing attempt finishes.
config.stopManual.name: Stop on manual move
config.stopManual.tooltip: Movement, jump, dash, menus, or cancel should stop automation.
config.requireRod.name: Require fishing rod
config.requireRod.tooltip: Only start when the selected quick-slot item is a fishing rod.
config.castRelease.name: Cast release progress
config.castRelease.tooltip: 0 skips charging; 1 waits for full charge.
config.recastDelay.name: Recast delay
config.recastDelay.tooltip: Delay before the next cast after pull/result. Auto recast itself is currently forced on by the experimental service.
config.skipMinigame.name: Skip after instant bite
config.skipMinigame.tooltip: Experimental: only affects the Instant Bite transition by routing directly to pull/result. It is not an independent minigame skip.
config.autoCompleteMinigame.name: Delayed minigame success
config.autoCompleteMinigame.tooltip: Experimental: after a real minigame has been visible briefly, force its native status to Success. This is not a progress-aware solver.
config.instantBite.name: Instant bite
config.instantBite.tooltip: Verified for the wait phase, still experimental; changes bite timing.
config.fastAnimations.name: Fast animations (may no-op)
config.fastAnimations.tooltip: Attempts to speed cast/pull animators when those animator fields are reachable; otherwise it safely does nothing.
config.fastMultiplier.name: Animation multiplier
config.fastMultiplier.tooltip: Multiplier used only when a supported fishing animator path is found.
config.verbose.name: Verbose logs
